responsibility: Implements the ISO COROUTINES runtime on top of gm2 low-level thread and interrupt primitives from RTco and RTint. It owns coroutine descriptors, context-switch bookkeeping, interrupt-source attachment lists, exception-state preservation across transfers, and the LISTEN/IOTRANSFER handlers that resume coroutines on I/O or timer interrupts; it consumes thread creation/semaphore/interrupt services and produces the coroutine control substrate used by Processes and other concurrent runtime code.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for COROUTINES: unlike COROUTINES.def, it defines coroutine records, interrupt-source attachment lists, exception-state switching, and the concrete RTco/RTint-backed logic behind NEWCOROUTINE, TRANSFER, IOTRANSFER, LISTEN, and related operations.
